This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

# Team Documentation Workflow

Collaboration centered on the `docs/` directory.

## Knowledge Architecture (domain-axis)

Docs are organized by what they're *about*, not by lifecycle stage. A doc's freshness lives in its TL;DR (and `Last touched:` for active areas) — not by which directory it sits in. Completed work stays co-located with its domain. There is no `archives/` directory — if a doc no longer earns its keep, delete it; if a lasting lesson hides inside it, lift that lesson into `lessons/` first, then delete.

```
docs/
├── index.md           # Routing table — every doc must be listed here
├── roadmap/           # Strategic plans, quarterly direction, milestones
├── models/<line>/     # Per-model living docs (qwen3, qwen35, kimi-k2, ...)
│                      # — design, accuracy, perf, refactor records, gotchas
├── subsystems/<area>/ # Cross-cutting components (runtime, scheduler, frontend, kernels)
├── playbooks/         # Reusable how-to: benching, profiling, accuracy, onboarding
├── lessons/           # Tribal knowledge from research / other projects
├── benchmarks/        # Standalone benchmark snapshots and eval reports
├── conventions/       # Ongoing standards (bench regression, coding style)
└── private/           # Local-only notes (gitignored)
```

Classification rule at capture time:
- Is it tied to a specific model? → `models/<line>/`
- A specific subsystem? → `subsystems/<area>/`
- Reusable how-to applicable across models? → `playbooks/`
- Lasting lesson from elsewhere (other repo, research, postmortem)? → `lessons/`
- Snapshot of measurement, not a doc that evolves? → `benchmarks/`
- Strategic / cross-cutting plan? → `roadmap/`

If you can't pick one, the doc probably needs splitting.

## Documentation Style

- Docs cover what `--help` and code can't: pitfalls, diagnostic paths, decision context. Don't restate CLI reference.
- Every command in a doc must be run and verified before committing. Unverified commands are technical debt.
- The only required header is a one-line **TL;DR**. Keep it true; that's the contract.
- For `models/<line>/` and `subsystems/<area>/` docs, add `Last touched: YYYY-MM` and bump it when you do meaningful work on the doc (not for typo fixes). The date is a fact, not a judgement — readers infer freshness themselves.
- `playbooks/`, `lessons/`, `conventions/`, `roadmap/`, `benchmarks/`, `archives/` don't need a freshness stamp. They're either timeless until disproven, or self-dated, or explicitly inert.
- No `Status:` enum. Enum fields go stale exactly when you need them most.

## index.md Drift Policy

`index.md` is a routing table with a scanning-friendly TL;DR column. It is *allowed to drift* from the TL;DR inside each doc — the doc body is authoritative. Update `index.md` when you create or delete a doc, or when the existing TL;DR is so wrong it actively misleads. Don't churn it on every doc edit.

## Core Principles (CODE)

Documentation exists to advance work, not to hoard information. Four steps when handling information:

1. **Capture**: Only record what materially advances the project. When in doubt, leave it out.
2. **Organize**: Action-oriented. Resist the urge to organize for organization's sake — structure should be just enough.
3. **Distill**: Refactor over append. When you learn something new or hit a pitfall, integrate it into the document body — don't pile a changelog at the bottom.
4. **Express**: Every document must point to a next step. Split unwieldy documents proactively. Active documents must note the current blocker or next action.

## Collaboration Lifecycle

**Sync**

At the start of each session, you must read `index.md` and load the documents needed for the task at hand.

**Execute**
- Update relevant documents as you go. When a new problem or idea arises, create a document in the appropriate domain directory (see classification rule above).
- Record *why* a decision was made, not just *what* was done.

**Commit**

When a session wraps up:
- Update the TL;DR (and `Last touched`, where applicable) at the top of each modified document.
- Update `index.md` only when you created or deleted a doc, or when its TL;DR row is now misleading (see Drift Policy above).

每篇讲义的 `action` 按以下规则设置：

- `"keep"`

- `"update"`

- `"new"`

  架构、主流程、公共接口、核心模型发生重大变化，旧讲义需要重建。

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: Bash
tools.description:
Executes a bash command and returns its output.

- Working directory persists between calls, but prefer absolute paths — `cd` in a compound command can trigger a permission prompt. Shell state (env vars, functions) does not persist; the shell is initialized from the user's profile.
- IMPORTANT: Avoid using this tool to run `find`, `grep`, `cat`, `head`, `tail`, `sed`, `awk`, or `echo` commands, unless explicitly instructed or after you have verified that a dedicated tool cannot accomplish your task. Instead, use the appropriate dedicated tool as this will provide a much better experience for the user.
- Command output is displayed to you, not reliably to the user.
- `timeout` is in milliseconds: default 120000, max 600000 for a foreground command.
- `run_in_background` runs the command detached: it keeps running across turns and re-invokes you when it exits. With it, `timeout` is how long the command may run in the background (default 600000, max 7200000); at that limit it is stopped and you are re-invoked. No `&` needed. Foreground `sleep` is blocked; use Monitor with an until-loop to wait on a condition.

# Git
- Interactive flags (`-i`, e.g. `git rebase -i`, `git add -i`) are not supported in this environment.
- Use the `gh` CLI for GitHub operations (PRs, issues, API).
- GitHub notifies the owner of any `@name` written in a PR, issue, or comment. Write a bare `@name` only for a real login you mean to notify. Put roles, placeholders, and code (`@human`, `@reviewer`, `@types/node`) in backticks or drop the `@`, even when copied from project files.
- Commit or push only when the user asks. If on the default branch, branch first.
- End git commit messages and PR bodies with the attribution lines given in the conversation's system-reminder, when one is present.

description.description:
Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice. Never use words like "complex" or "risk" in the description - just describe what it does.

Say what the command does in plain words: do not echo the command's text, its flags, or file paths - the user reads this description, often without seeing the command.

For simple commands (git, npm, standard CLI tools), keep it brief (5-10 words):
- ls → "List files in current directory"
- git status → "Show working tree status"
- npm install → "Install package dependencies"

For commands that are harder to parse at a glance (piped commands, obscure flags, etc.), add enough context to clarify what it does:
- find . -name "*.tmp" -exec rm {} \; → "Find and delete all .tmp files recursively"
- git reset --hard origin/main → "Discard all local changes and match remote main"
- curl -s url | jq '.data[]' → "Fetch JSON from URL and extract data array elements"

Works across all output modes: content (limits output lines), files_with_matches (limits file paths), count (limits count entries). Defaults to 250 when unspecified. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.

Before writing a script, load the `workflow-authoring` skill — the workflow authoring reference: script API and gotchas, resume, the **Ultracode** section, quality patterns, worked examples.

This session has the default workflow size guideline: medium — keep workflows under 10 agents. This is a guideline, not a hard limit — follow it unless the user's prompt calls for a different scale. The user can raise or remove it with "Dynamic workflow size" in /config.

599	/// Free VRAM held back from the context-cap budget on every rank, covering
600	/// the post-probe allocations the exact arena ledger does not model: the
601	/// MLA W_UK/W_UV bf16 dequant during build (~1.1 GiB net over the freed fp8
602	/// kv_b), DeepEP collective buffers, the 8 whole-step graph instantiations,
603	/// cuBLAS workspaces, and allocator fragmentation. The SM100 DeepGEMM delta
604	/// over the retired weight-only chain is charged exactly and separately.
605	/// Measured on 8×H200
606	/// (jz-38, 2026-07-06): the worst rank's non-arena post-probe allocations
607	/// came to ~3.05 GiB, so 5 GiB leaves ~2 GiB of post-build headroom over
608	/// the [`GLM52_POST_BUILD_MIN_FREE_BYTES`] floor; the post-build re-probe
609	/// below turns any drift into a launch failure instead of a mid-serving
610	/// OOM.
611	const GLM52_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES: usize = 5 << 30;
612	
613	/// Extra reserve when the DSpark drafter is enabled: the replicated draft
614	/// weights (~3.8 GiB bf16) plus its dense forward scratch, which load after
615	/// the probe. The drafter's cap-scaled buffers are in the exact ledger
616	/// (`glm52_dspark_arena_bytes`), not here.
617	const GLM52_DSPARK_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES: usize = 5 << 30;
618	
619	/// Fixed prefill workspace reserve: the row-block-bounded MoE scratch
620	/// (gathered fp8 routes + grouped W2 output), the attention/dense sub-tile
621	/// buffers, the unpacked bf16 KV pool, and the GEMM workspaces.
622	const GLM52_PREFILL_FIXED_SCRATCH_BYTES: usize = 3 << 30;
623	
624	/// Estimated scratch bytes per token row (chunk-scale activations, MLA
625	/// front/query buffers, indexer carry, router logits).
626	const GLM52_PREFILL_SCRATCH_BYTES_PER_TOKEN: usize = 160 << 10;
627	
628	/// The smallest cap worth serving with (the pre-refactor bring-up value);
629	/// a budget below this is a misconfiguration, not a working engine.
630	const GLM52_MIN_MODEL_LEN: usize = 4096;
631	
632	/// Free VRAM every rank must still have AFTER the model, DeepEP contexts,
633	/// and the optional drafter are fully resident — headroom for the whole-step
634	/// graph instantiations (captured lazily by the engine) and allocator
635	/// fragmentation. The post-build re-probe fails launch below this, so a
636	/// ledger/reserve drift crashes at startup, not mid-serving.
637	const GLM52_POST_BUILD_MIN_FREE_BYTES: usize = 1 << 30;
638	
639	/// The launch-time context-cap decision and the numbers behind it — the log
640	/// line and the tests consume the same values the decision used, so they
641	/// cannot drift apart. The pool block count is NOT decided here anymore:
642	/// the ledger only provides the fill floor, and the authoritative count
643	/// comes from the measured two-phase build (`build_rank_models`).
644	#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)]
645	struct Glm52ContextBudget {
646	    max_model_len: usize,
647	    /// Exact bytes the cap costs a rank at the floor pool (build arenas +
648	    /// drafter lane) — an initial estimate for the startup log.
649	    arena_bytes: usize,
650	    reserve_bytes: usize,
651	    budget_bytes: usize,
652	    /// The measured fill's floor: the legacy nominal `slots x cap` pool when
653	    /// the ledger says it fits, else a one-request pool (the
654	    /// explicit-big-cap shape the pool decoupling exists for).
655	    floor_blocks: usize,
656	}
657	
658	/// Exact cap-scaled bytes a rank allocates for a candidate cap: the build
659	/// arenas plus the selected speculative lane.
660	fn glm52_cap_bytes(
661	    max_model_len: usize,
662	    pool_blocks: usize,
663	    drafter: &Glm52Drafter,
664	    prefill_only: bool,
665	    moe_topo: Glm52MoeTopo,
666	) -> Result<usize> {
667	    Ok(glm52_arena_bytes(max_model_len, pool_blocks, prefill_only)?
668	        + if drafter.is_dspark() {
669	            crate::dspark::glm52_dspark_arena_bytes(max_model_len)
670	        } else if drafter.is_mtp() {
671	            crate::mtp::glm52_mtp_arena_bytes(max_model_len, pool_blocks, moe_topo)?
672	        } else {
673	            0
674	        })
675	}
676	
677	/// The smallest useful pool: one max-length request's pages plus the
678	/// padding block and one spare.
679	fn glm52_one_request_pool_blocks(max_model_len: usize) -> usize {
680	    (max_model_len + 1).div_ceil(GLM52_MODEL_LEN_ALIGN) + 2
681	}
682	
683	/// Free VRAM held back from the measured KV fill on every rank — the ONLY
684	/// remaining estimate in the pool sizing. Everything the fill can measure is
685	/// already resident when the workers report free VRAM (the fixed build), and
686	/// the exactly-known post-finish charges (DeepGEMM buffers, the DSpark lane)
687	/// are subtracted separately; this covers what allocates after FinishKv and
688	/// has no exact ledger — the whole-step CUDA graph instantiations (captured
689	/// lazily by the engines), cuBLAS/FlashInfer workspaces, and allocator
690	/// fragmentation. `GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB` overrides.
691	fn glm52_graph_reserve_bytes() -> usize {
692	    (std::env::var("GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB")
693	        .ok()
694	        .and_then(|v| v.parse::<usize>().ok())
695	        .unwrap_or(3))
696	        << 30
697	}

699	/// The measured KV fill (#818, two-phase build): after every rank built its
700	/// fixed half, the fleet-minimum free VRAM — minus the graph reserve and the
701	/// exactly-known post-finish charges — is spent on pool blocks at the
702	/// ledger's exact per-block slab cost. The floor is never reduced (the
703	/// nominal pool where affordable, else one max-length request).
704	fn glm52_measured_pool_blocks(
705	    min_free_bytes: usize,
706	    post_finish_bytes: usize,
707	    slab_bytes_per_block: usize,
708	    floor_blocks: usize,
709	) -> usize {
710	    let usable = min_free_bytes.saturating_sub(glm52_graph_reserve_bytes() + post_finish_bytes);
711	    if slab_bytes_per_block == 0 {
712	        return floor_blocks;
713	    }
714	    (usable / slab_bytes_per_block).max(floor_blocks)
715	}

718	/// binary search finds the largest cap whose nominal-pool cost fits), and
719	/// the floor the budget fill starts from.
720	fn glm52_nominal_pool_blocks(max_model_len: usize) -> usize {
721	    glm52_pool_blocks(max_model_len, model::glm52_decode_slots())

725	    prefill_only: Option<Glm52PrefillOnlyOptions>,
726	) -> Result<usize> {
727	    let Some(prefill) = prefill_only else {
728	        return Ok(0);

730	    prefill
731	        .chunk_size
732	        .checked_mul(GLM52_PREFILL_SCRATCH_BYTES_PER_TOKEN)
733	        .and_then(|bytes| bytes.checked_add(GLM52_PREFILL_FIXED_SCRATCH_BYTES))

735	}

740	/// fleet-minimum free bytes — kept free of CUDA so the policy is
741	/// unit-testable. Auto mode binary-searches the largest aligned cap that
742	/// fits; an explicit cap must be aligned and fit, or launch fails.
743	fn derive_max_model_len(
744	    requested: Option<usize>,

754	        } else {

758	    let budget_bytes = min_free_vram_bytes.saturating_sub(reserve_bytes);

# 显存预算：上下文上限推导与实测 KV 池填充

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 看懂 `glm52_cap_bytes` 这本「精确账本」：为什么一个候选上下文上限（cap）的显存开销可以写成**纯算术**，以及这让它可以被单元测试。
2. 复述 `derive_max_model_len` 的两条路径：显式 `--max-model-len` 的四道校验门，与自动模式在 64 对齐候选上的二分搜索。
3. 解释 #818 之后的**两阶段实测填充**：cap 与 KV 池容量解耦，池大小由「构建后实测的 fleet 最小空闲 VRAM ÷ 每块 slab 边际成本」决定，floor 池与 `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 是两道栅栏。
4. 说明 post-build headroom 再探测如何把「账本漂移」变成启动期失败，而不是服务中途 OOM。

本讲只回答一个问题：**启动那一刻，这台机器上每个请求最多能吃多长的上下文、整个 rank 能装下多少 KV 页？**

## 2. 前置知识

- **显存（VRAM）预算**：权重加载完之后，GPU 上剩余的空闲显存要在「KV cache 池」「CUDA Graph 实例」「cuBLAS/DeepGEMM 工作区」「碎片」之间分配。本讲讨论的就是这笔分配的决策代码。
- **fleet 最小值**：EP 模式下每个 rank 持有自己那份权重和 KV，任何分配决策都必须按**所有 rank 里最穷的那个**来定，否则最穷的 rank 会 OOM 拖垮整个集体通信组（fate-sharing）。
- **cap（`max_model_len`）与池（pool）**：cap 是*单个请求*的上下文长度上限；池是 *rank 全局*的 KV 页总数。旧设计里池 = `slots × cap`（每个 slot 都按满 cap 预留），两者耦合；#818 之后解耦——cap 只要求「装得下一个满长请求」，池容量由实测空闲显存另外决定。
- **64-token 页**：GLM5.2 的 KV 以 64 token 为一页（FlashMLA 稀疏页 = index-K 缓存块 = 对齐单位，u4-l2 会展开）。所以 cap 必须是 64 的倍数，池以「块」为单位计数。
- **二分搜索的单调性**：候选 cap 的开销随 cap 单调不减，于是「找最大的放得下的 cap」可以在对齐候选上二分，代价是对数次账本计算而不是线性扫描。
- **精确账本 vs 经验 reserve**：能从常量精确算出的字节数走账本；无法建模的（碎片、graph 实例）走经验 reserve 常量。本讲的核心张力就在这两类之间。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| [src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs) | 预算决策的家：reserve 常量、`glm52_cap_bytes`、`derive_max_model_len`、`build_rank_models`（实测填充）、`ensure_post_build_headroom`，以及 `max_model_len_tests` 单测 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 精确账本 glm52_cap_bytes：一个候选 cap 的每一字节

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

要回答「这个 cap 放不放得下」，前提是能**精确**算出它花多少字节。GLM5.2 的选择是：把所有随 cap 与池块数线性变化的分配写成纯函数 `glm52_arena_bytes`（几何常量全部来自 u2-l1 的编译期 `const`），再加上投机通道的开销，就是 `glm52_cap_bytes`。精确账本带来两个直接收益：

- **可单测**：函数不碰 CUDA，测试可以拿假想的空闲字节数反演预算（见 4.2.4）。
- **可作边际差分**：账本对块数严格线性，`cost(blocks+1) − cost(blocks)` 就是每块的 slab 边际成本，实测填充直接拿它当单价（见 4.3）。

无法精确建模的部分不许混进账本，而是走 reserve 常量（4.2 讲），两类字节泾渭分明。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
glm52_cap_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, drafter, prefill_only, moe_topo)
  = glm52_arena_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, prefill_only)   # KV slab + 各类表
  + dspark ? glm52_dspark_arena_bytes(cap)              # DSpark 草稿通道（只随 cap 缩放）
  | mtp    ? glm52_mtp_arena_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, topo)  # native MTP（随 cap 与块数）
  | none   ? 0
```

`glm52_arena_bytes` 内部是五项求和：

1. **slab**：`pool_blocks × 3,503,040 B + 3,502,592 B`（每块一页 stride，外加一页内容的尾部余量）；
2. **rope 表**：`2 × cap × 32 × 2 B`（cos/sin，bf16）；
3. **indexer logits 桶缓冲**：所有 decode bucket 行数之和 × `cap` 向上取整到 256 × 6 B（bf16 + f32）；
4. **块表**：bucket 行数之和 × 表宽 × 4 B；
5. **prefill 解包池**（仅 prefill-only）：`pool_blocks × 64 × 512 × 2 B + pool_blocks × 4 B`。

其中一页的内容账是纯几何（u4-l2 展开）：

\[ 78 \times (64 \times 656) + 21 \times (64 \times 128 + 64 \times 4) + (64 \times 656) + (64 \times 128 + 64 \times 4) = 3{,}274{,}752 + 177{,}408 + 50{,}432 = 3{,}502{,}592 \text{ B} \]

即 78 个 MLA 切片 + 21 个 full-indexer 的 index-K 切片 + 第 78 层 MTP 镜像（一个 MLA 切片 + 一个 index-K 切片）。stride 把内容向上取整到 656-byte 的 token 行：\( 5{,}340 \times 656 = 3{,}503{,}040 \) B。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:660-675](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L660-L675) 是账本入口：固定构建 arena 加上所选投机通道的开销。

[model/mod.rs:205-240](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L205-L240) 是五项求和的实现；slab 一项就是 `块数 × GLM52_KV_PAGE_STRIDE + GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES`。

[model/mod.rs:139-163](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L139-L163) 钉死页的三个字节常量，并用编译期断言保证 stride 是 656 的倍数、pad 尾巴不足一行——这正是边际差分成立的前提。

[model/mod.rs:177-203](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L177-L203) `glm52_page_layout` 用同一份构造把内容账加出来并 `assert_eq!` 到 `GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES`——**布局函数和字节常量互为对方的测试**，谁漂移谁编译期/测试期爆红。

[model/mod.rs:112-130](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L112-L130) 定义对齐常量与 nominal 池公式：一个 slot 的终身页数是 \( \lceil (cap+1)/64 \rceil \)（+1 来自悬空 token 契约，u7-l4 展开），池再 `+1` 是 padding 页（block 0）。

[model/mod.rs:943-1021](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L943-L1021) 是消费端：`finish_kv` 真正 `alloc_zeros` 这块 slab，行数是 `pool_blocks + scratch_blocks`（EP MTP 的草稿 scratch 页排在池区之后），与账本公式逐字对应。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲手验证页内容账，确信 `3,502,592` 不是魔法数。
2. **操作步骤**：

   - 再算 stride：\( \lceil 3{,}502{,}592 / 656 \rceil \times 656 \)。
3. **需要观察的现象**：两个结果分别等于 `GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES` 与 `GLM52_KV_PAGE_STRIDE`；pad 尾巴 = 448 B < 656 B，恰好满足 [model/mod.rs:159-163](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L159-L163) 的编译期断言。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：prefill-only 形态下每多买一个池块，边际成本比 decode 形态多多少字节？
**答案**：多 `64 × 512 × 2 + 4 = 65,540` B（解包 bf16 KV 池 + 每块 4 字节），见 [model/mod.rs:230-238](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L230-L238) 的 `prefill_unpacked` 项；decode 形态该项为 0。

**练习 2**：为什么账本对 `pool_blocks` 必须严格线性？
**答案**：因为实测填充用 `cost(floor+1) − cost(floor)` 当每块单价（[lib.rs:1365-1382](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1365-L1382)）；只要账本线性，一次差分就是任意块数下的边际成本，除法即可换算块数。若存在非线性项（如按池大小分档的表），差分就不再代表单价。

**练习 3**：账本为什么把 DSpark 与 native MTP 写成两个不同签名（一个只吃 `cap`，一个吃 `cap + pool_blocks + topo`）？
**答案**：DSpark 草稿状态只随 cap 缩放（[lib.rs:668-671](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L668-L671)）；native MTP 的草稿 KV 镜像住在 slab 里、还随拓扑走 EP scratch 页，所以随池块数与拓扑缩放。签名差异本身就是开销结构的文档。

### 4.2 derive_max_model_len：显式校验与自动二分

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

权重落 GPU 后，引擎从加载报告取 fleet 最小空闲 VRAM（[lib.rs:916-922](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L916-L922)），先精确扣掉两笔探测后才会落地的开销——MLA q_a|kv_a 打包孪生（[mla_front.rs:220-227](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L220-L227)）与 SM100 DeepGEMM 增量（[moe_ep.rs:69-73](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/moe_ep.rs#L69-L73)），见 [lib.rs:923-939](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L923-L939)。然后 `derive_max_model_len` 在这笔预算上做决策：

- **reserve 分层**：先扣经验 reserve 得到 `budget_bytes`：
  - `GLM52_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES = 5 GiB`（[lib.rs:599-611](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L599-L611)）：覆盖探测后无法精确建模的分配——MLA W_UK/W_UV 反量化净增量、DeepEP 集合通信缓冲、8 个整步 graph 实例、cuBLAS 工作区、碎片。注释里记录了 8×H200 实测最差 rank 约 3.05 GiB，留 ~2 GiB 余量。
  - DSpark 开启时再加 `GLM52_DSPARK_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES = 5 GiB`（复制式草稿权重 + dense scratch，在探测*之后*加载）。
  - prefill-only 再加 scratch 预留：`3 GiB 固定 + 160 KiB × chunk 行数`（[lib.rs:724-735](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L724-L735)）。
- **显式 cap**（用户给了 `--max-model-len`）：四道门全部通过才接受。
- **自动模式**：在 64 对齐候选上二分找「nominal 池也放得下」的最大 cap。
- **floor 池**：决策最后给出实测填充的下限——nominal 池（`slots × cap`）放得下就用 nominal（与旧行为一致），否则退到「一个满长请求」池。

设计哲学：**宁可启动失败，不可带病服务**。预算不足时错误消息把每个数字（需求、预算、reserve、探测值）都打出来，见 [lib.rs:792-802](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L792-L802)。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
budget = min_free_vram − post_weight_charge − reserve
显式路径（requested = Some(C)）:
  1) C ≥ 4096（GLM52_MIN_MODEL_LEN）
  2) C ≤ 1,048,576（GLM52_MAX_CONTEXT，checkpoint 的 max_position_embeddings）
  3) C % 64 == 0（否则报出两侧最近的合法值）
  4) cap_bytes(C, one_request_pool(C)) + graph_reserve ≤ budget
自动路径（requested = None）:
  在 [0, MAX_CONTEXT/64] 上二分，谓词 = cap_bytes(c·64, nominal_pool(c·64)) ≤ budget
  结果 < 4096 则拒绝启动
floor:
  cap_bytes(cap, nominal) ≤ budget ? nominal : one_request(cap)
```

注意两条路径用的**池假设不同**：自动模式按 nominal（slots × cap）搜索——语义是「连传统并发池都放得下的最大 cap」；显式路径只需 one-request 池放得下（#818 解耦的核心：显式大 cap 合法，并发交给实测填充给）。二分正确性依赖账本对 cap 单调；`mid = ⌈(lo+hi)/2⌉` 保证区间长度为 1 时也能推进。

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:743-758](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L743-L758) 是函数签名与 reserve/budget 的组装，函数 doc 直说「kept free of CUDA so the policy is unit-testable」。

[lib.rs:759-803](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L759-L803) 显式路径：四道 ensure 门；第 4 道把 graph reserve 一起算进需求——注释解释了为什么：cap 落在 `(budget−reserve, budget]` 区间时若不校验，实测填充会退到 one-request 池「侥幸通过」，然后在 FinishKv 或懒捕获 graph 时裸 OOM。

[lib.rs:804-833](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L804-L833) 自动路径二分；推导结果低于 `GLM52_MIN_MODEL_LEN = 4096` 时报错——预算小到这种程度是配置错误，不是可服务的引擎（[lib.rs:628-630](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L628-L630)）。

#### 4.2.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：用户传 `--max-model-len 5000` 会发生什么？
**答案**：第 3 道门拒绝：5000 不是 64 的倍数，错误消息给出两侧最近合法值 4992 与 5056（[lib.rs:769-775](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L769-L775)）；单测 [lib.rs:1993-2009](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1993-L2009) 断言了消息里确实含这两个数。项目哲学是拒绝而非静默取整。

**练习 2**：cap = 99,968、8 个 slot 时，nominal 池与 one-request 池各多少块？
**答案**：每 slot 页数 \( \lceil 99{,}969/64 \rceil = 1{,}563 \)；nominal = 8 × 1,563 + 1 = 12,505 块；one-request = 1,563 + 2 = 1,565 块（[lib.rs:679-681](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L679-L681)、[lib.rs:720-722](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L720-L722)）。后者约为前者的 1/8——这就是显式大 cap 能启动的原因。

**练习 3**：为什么 `derived_cap_never_exceeds_the_checkpoint_ceiling` 要拿 `usize::MAX / 2` 这么夸张的空闲值？
**答案**：验证二分的上界 `hi = GLM52_MAX_CONTEXT / 64`（[lib.rs:807](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L807)）：显存再富裕，cap 也封顶在 checkpoint 的 `max_position_embeddings = 1,048,576`（[config.rs:18](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/config.rs#L18)），不会拿模型没学过的位置外推。

### 4.3 measured pool fill：两阶段构建与 slab 边际成本

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

cap 定了之后，池该买多少块？旧答案是 `slots × cap`（与 cap 耦合）；#818 之后改成**实测填充**：

1. 每个 worker 先做**阶段一构建**（`build_fixed`）：分配一切不随池大小变化的固定部分，然后**实测**本卡空闲 VRAM 并回报（[runner.rs:714-741](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L714-L741)）。
2. 引擎取 fleet 最小值，减去 graph reserve（默认 3 GiB，`GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB` 可覆盖）与**已知的 post-finish 开销**（DeepGEMM 缓冲、DSpark 草稿权重，[lib.rs:987-992](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L987-L992)），再除以账本差分出的每块 slab 单价，就是可负担块数；但它**永远不低于 floor**（[lib.rs:704-715](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L704-L715)）。
3. 每个 worker 做**阶段二**（`finish_kv`）：按定好的块数分配 slab 并回报（[runner.rs:743-763](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L743-L763)）。

好处：**池容量与 cap 解耦**。同一个 cap 下，显存多就多买页（更多并发、更长前缀缓存驻留），显存少就少买页；cap 只受 one-request 门槛约束。调度侧的 `BlockPool` 与 admission（u7-l4）按页数做终身预留，所以池小一点也不影响正确性，只影响并发度。

两道栅栏保护 `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS`（手工钉死池大小的 A/B 旋钮）：

- **下栅栏**：pin ≥ one-request 池——低于它等于宣传一个任何请求都放不下的 cap，admission 会让不可能的请求永远堵在 FIFO 头。
- **上栅栏**：pin ≤ 实测可负担块数——高于它要么 slab 分配直接失败，要么吃掉 graph reserve 死在预捕获。

两道都「拒绝启动，报出数字」，见 [lib.rs:1387-1413](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1387-L1413)。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
阶段一: 所有 worker build_fixed → 各自回报 free_vram（全部回报后才继续）
min_free = min(回报值)
usable = min_free − graph_reserve(默认 3 GiB) − post_finish_reserve
blocks  = max(usable / slab_bytes_per_block, floor_blocks)
   其中 slab_bytes_per_block = cap_bytes(floor+1) − cap_bytes(floor)   # 账本差分
GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS=P 时:
   P ≥ one_request(cap) 且 P ≤ blocks(以 one_request 为 floor 重算) 才接受 P
阶段二: 所有 worker finish_kv(blocks)
```

两个阶段**刻意分开**：阶段一可能 OOM 或打包漂移失败，必须所有 rank 都报成功才有人进入阶段二——否则一个 rank 失败会把同伴晾在集合通信初始化里（[lib.rs:1319-1327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1319-L1327) 的 doc 详述了这个失败语义）。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:1342-1364](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1342-L1364) 阶段一的异步下发与回收；注意 rank 用**全局编号**标注日志（多进程 fleet 下每个进程的第一个 worker 不都叫 rank 0）。

[lib.rs:1365-1382](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1365-L1382) slab 边际成本：对同一本账本做 `floor+1` 与 `floor` 两次求值再相减，注释点明「账本线性，一次差分即边际」。

[lib.rs:1383-1421](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1383-L1421) `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 的两道栅栏与未设置时的实测填充。

[lib.rs:1874-1891](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1874-L1891) 实测填充的单测：三个断言分别覆盖「只剩 reserve 时 floor 不缩水」「每字节按边际单价买块」「已知 post-finish 开销与 reserve 一并扣减」。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：手推一次实测填充，并预判 `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 越栅栏时的失败消息。
2. **操作步骤**：

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么实测填充只在阶段一与阶段二**之间**做，而不是加载权重前就定好池？
**答案**：因为只有阶段一之后，所有固定分配（权重、buckets、rope 表、indexer 桶缓冲）才真正落地，空闲 VRAM 才是可信的测量值；加载前估算要复刻整个 CUDA 分配器的行为，必然回到经验常量。两阶段构建让「测量」成为可能（[lib.rs:1319-1327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1319-L1327)）。

**练习 2**：`GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB` 是池填充里「唯一剩下的估计」（[lib.rs:683-690](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L683-L690)）。为什么它不像 5 GiB reserve 那样拆成精确项？
**答案**：它能覆盖的开销（懒捕获的整步 graph 实例、cuBLAS/FlashInfer 工作区、碎片）没有常量公式可依，且发生在 FinishKv *之后*——此时已无法再改池大小，只能预留。做成旋钮允许在实测漂移时手工调大调小做 A/B。

**练习 3**：nominal 池作 floor 有什么兼容性意义？
**答案**：显存宽裕时 `max(usable/单价, nominal) = nominal` 附近，行为与解耦前的旧默认几乎一致（单测 `floor_is_the_nominal_pool_when_the_ledger_affords_it`，[lib.rs:1844-1853](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1844-L1853)）；floor 只在「显式大 cap 挤掉了 nominal」时才退到 one-request——解耦是**放宽**约束而非改变默认。

### 4.4 post-build headroom 再探测

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

预算再精确也是模型。若 reserve/账本随代码演进漂移（比如新加一条未入账的分配），错误应该在**启动期**爆出来，而不是服务中途 OOM——后者在 EP fleet 里意味着集体通信组整体坍塌、难以归因。所以构建完成后引擎再探一次每 rank 的空闲 VRAM，低于 `GLM52_POST_BUILD_MIN_FREE_BYTES = 1 GiB` 就拒绝启动（[lib.rs:632-637](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L632-L637)）：这 1 GiB 是 graph 实例化与碎片的最小呼吸空间。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
FinishKv 全员完成 → SetupComm 之前/前后（post_comm_startup 闭包内）
对每个 worker 异步发 FreeVram 探测 → 回收每 rank 空闲值
free < 1 GiB ? 启动失败（错误带具体数字） : 记 info 日志继续
```

它在 [lib.rs:1034-1041](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1034-L1041) 的 `post_comm_startup` 闭包里被调用，位于 prefill kernel 预检与 DSpark 草稿加载之后、KV store 构建之前。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:1293-1317](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1293-L1317) `ensure_post_build_headroom`：全员异步探测、逐 rank 校验、失败消息建议「调低 --max-model-len 或释放显存」，成功则把每 rank 空闲值打进日志。

[runner.rs:740](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L740) 与 [runner.rs:694](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L694) 是同一探测原语的三个使用点：权重加载报告、阶段一回报、显式 FreeVram 指令——一次实现，三处复用。

[mla_front.rs:213-219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L213-L219) 的 doc 是这条防线的注脚：q_a|kv_a 孪生约 1.2 GiB 若不入账，「未入账的分配会吃掉 post-build headroom 地板」；混合架构 fleet 里账本可能算错，re-probe 是兜底。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：re-probe 的地板是 1 GiB，而 4.2 的 reserve 是 5 GiB，两者矛盾吗？
**答案**：不矛盾，层次不同。5 GiB reserve 是*进入预算前*的经验扣减（覆盖账本外开销并留余量）；1 GiB 是*全部构建完成后*的最终校验地板——若实际只花了 reserve 的一半，re-probe 会放行更多隐性余量；若开销超预算，re-probe 兜底。前者防超支，后者防漂移。

**练习 2**：为什么 re-probe 失败是可接受的启动失败，而服务中途 OOM 不可接受？
**答案**：启动失败发生在任何集合通信组进入长生命周期之前（或配合广播 Shutdown 拆除，见 [lib.rs:993-1001](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L993-L1001)），错误定位直接；服务中 OOM 会让一个 rank 掉队，free-running fleet 里其余 rank 全速空转直到 DeepEP 超时（约 100 s），事后难以归因。这与 u7-l1 的 fate-sharing 纪律一脉相承。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：写一个「GLM5.2 显存预算模拟器」，把本讲三段决策串成一条链。**

用 Python 复刻公式（**示例代码**，非项目源码，数字以源码常量为准）：

```python
# 示例代码：GLM5.2 显存预算模拟器（decode / EP8 / 无 drafter 的简化版）
PAGE_STRIDE = 3_503_040          # model/mod.rs GLM52_KV_PAGE_STRIDE
CONTENT     = 3_502_592          # GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES
MLA_TOKENS  = 576 // 9           # 每层 rope 半维 32 * 2 表 * bf16 —— 见下方练习
RESERVE     = 5 << 30            # lib.rs GLM52_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES
GRAPH_RESERVE = 3 << 30          # glm52_graph_reserve_bytes 默认
MIN_LEN, MAX_CTX, ALIGN = 4096, 1_048_576, 64
BUCKET_ROWS = sum([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 48, 64, 96])   # GLM52_DECODE_BUCKETS 之和
SLOTS = 8

def arena(cap, blocks):                      # model/mod.rs glm52_arena_bytes 的 decode 分支
    slab = blocks * PAGE_STRIDE + CONTENT
    rope = 2 * cap * 32 * 2
    logits = BUCKET_ROWS * ((cap + 255) // 256 * 256) * (2 + 4)
    tables = BUCKET_ROWS * ((cap + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN) * 4
    return slab + rope + logits + tables

cap_bytes = arena                             # 无 drafter 时 glm52_cap_bytes == arena
one_request = lambda c: (c + 1 + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN + 2
nominal = lambda c: SLOTS * ((c + 1 + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN) + 1

def derive(free_after_weights):
    budget = free_after_weights - RESERVE
    lo, hi = 0, MAX_CTX // ALIGN
    while lo < hi:                            # lib.rs:804-833 的二分
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
        if cap_bytes(mid * ALIGN, nominal(mid * ALIGN)) <= budget: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid - 1
    cap = lo * ALIGN
    assert cap >= MIN_LEN
    floor = nominal(cap) if cap_bytes(cap, nominal(cap)) <= budget else one_request(cap)
    return cap, floor, budget

def fill(free_after_fixed, floor):            # lib.rs:704-715 实测填充
    usable = free_after_fixed - GRAPH_RESERVE
    unit = cap_bytes(0, floor + 1) - cap_bytes(0, floor)   # 差分 = PAGE_STRIDE
    return max(usable // unit, floor)

# 场景：权重后空闲 30 GiB、固定构建后 fleet 最小空闲 22 GiB
cap, floor, budget = derive(30 << 30)
blocks = fill(22 << 30, floor)
print(f"cap={cap}, floor={floor} blocks, pool={blocks} blocks (~{blocks*64/1024:.0f}K tokens)")
```

要求：

1. 跑通后回答：这个场景推导出多大的 cap？池比 nominal 多出多少块？
2. 修改 `SLOTS = 32`（对照 `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS`，[model/mod.rs:101-110](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L101-L110)），解释 cap 为什么变小、池为什么几乎不变——这正是「cap 与池解耦」的直观演示。
3. 找出代码里的一处故意留白（`MLA_TOKENS` 那行是干扰项，rope 项已在 `arena` 里实现）：删掉它。
4. 对照 [lib.rs:950-979](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L950-L979) 与 [lib.rs:1422-1434](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1422-L1434) 的真实日志字段，列出模拟器没建模的项（DSpark/MTP 通道、prefill scratch、post-finish 开销、DeepGEMM 计费、TP4 专属缓存）。

注意：模拟器只做教学推演；真实数字以启动日志为准。运行结果**待本地验证**。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **精确账本**：`glm52_cap_bytes = glm52_arena_bytes + 投机通道`，五项求和全部来自编译期几何常量，对 cap 与块数严格线性；线性性让「一次差分 = 每块 slab 单价（3,503,040 B）」。
- **cap 决策**：`derive_max_model_len` 不碰 CUDA 所以可单测；显式 cap 过四道门（最小值、checkpoint 上限、64 对齐、one-request 池 + graph reserve 放得下），自动模式按 nominal 池二分；两条路径的池假设不同是 #818 解耦的体现。
- **reserve 分层**：5 GiB 基础 reserve（账本外开销）+ DSpark 5 GiB + prefill scratch（3 GiB + 160 KiB/行）+ graph reserve（默认 3 GiB，池填充侧）+ 精确扣减（q_a|kv_a 孪生、DeepGEMM 增量）——精确与经验两类字节分开记账。
- **实测填充**：两阶段构建（build_fixed → 实测 fleet 最小空闲 → finish_kv），池 = max(可用字节 ÷ slab 单价, floor)；`GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 被上下两道栅栏夹住，越界即拒绝启动。
- **headroom 再探测**：构建完成后每 rank 空闲须 ≥ 1 GiB，把账本漂移变成带数字的启动失败而非服务中 OOM。
- **日志即合同**：启动日志打出的每个数字与决策、单测消费的是同一组值（`free_for` 用同一账本反演），三者不会漂移。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **u4-l2（KV 页布局）**：本讲把页当成 3.5 MB 的黑盒单价；下一讲拆开它——78 个 MLA 切片与 21 个 index-K 切片在一页内如何排布、为什么 stride 必须是 656 的倍数。
- **u7-l4（admission）**：池解耦之后，「一个请求终身要多少页」的公式 \( \lceil (prompt + max\_tokens)/64 \rceil \)（含悬空 token 的 +1）在 admission 里变成 honor-or-reject 的预留纪律，是池容量决定的并发语义的另一半。
- **u7-l5（分页 KV 前缀缓存）**：实测填充买来的池块由 `BlockPool` 管理，释放块按内容哈希匹配成前缀缓存——池的「多买」部分直接转化为缓存驻留能力。
- 顺手阅读 [lib.rs:1789-2097](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1789-L2097) 的整个 `max_model_len_tests` 模块：它是「策略纯函数化 + 同一账本反演」测试范式的最佳样例，值得在你自己的项目里复制。

# 显存预算：上下文上限推导与实测 KV 池填充

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 看懂 `glm52_cap_bytes` 这本「精确账本」：为什么一个候选上下文上限（cap）的显存开销可以写成**纯算术**，以及这让它可以被单元测试。
2. 复述 `derive_max_model_len` 的两条路径：显式 `--max-model-len` 的四道校验门，与自动模式在 64 对齐候选上的二分搜索。
3. 解释 #818 之后的**两阶段实测填充**：cap 与 KV 池容量解耦，池大小由「构建后实测的 fleet 最小空闲 VRAM ÷ 每块 slab 边际成本」决定，floor 池与 `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 是两道栅栏。
4. 说明 post-build headroom 再探测如何把「账本漂移」变成启动期失败，而不是服务中途 OOM。

本讲只回答一个问题：**启动那一刻，这台机器上每个请求最多能吃多长的上下文、整个 rank 能装下多少 KV 页？**

## 2. 前置知识

- **显存（VRAM）预算**：权重加载完之后，GPU 上剩余的空闲显存要在「KV cache 池」「CUDA Graph 实例」「cuBLAS/DeepGEMM 工作区」「碎片」之间分配。本讲讨论的就是这笔分配的决策代码。
- **fleet 最小值**：EP 模式下每个 rank 持有自己那份权重和 KV，任何分配决策都必须按**所有 rank 里最穷的那个**来定，否则最穷的 rank 会 OOM 拖垮整个集体通信组（fate-sharing）。
- **cap（`max_model_len`）与池（pool）**：cap 是*单个请求*的上下文长度上限；池是 *rank 全局*的 KV 页总数。旧设计里池 = `slots × cap`（每个 slot 都按满 cap 预留），两者耦合；#818 之后解耦——cap 只要求「装得下一个满长请求」，池容量由实测空闲显存另外决定。
- **64-token 页**：GLM5.2 的 KV 以 64 token 为一页（FlashMLA 稀疏页 = index-K 缓存块 = 对齐单位，u4-l2 会展开）。所以 cap 必须是 64 的倍数，池以「块」为单位计数。
- **二分搜索的单调性**：候选 cap 的开销随 cap 单调不减，于是「找最大的放得下的 cap」可以在对齐候选上二分，代价是对数次账本计算而不是线性扫描。
- **精确账本 vs 经验 reserve**：能从常量精确算出的字节数走账本；无法建模的（碎片、graph 实例）走经验 reserve 常量。本讲的核心张力就在这两类之间。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 作用 |
|------|------|
| [src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs) | 预算决策的家：reserve 常量、`glm52_cap_bytes`、`derive_max_model_len`、`build_rank_models`（实测填充）、`ensure_post_build_headroom`，以及 `max_model_len_tests` 单测 |
| [src/model/mod.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs) | 页几何常量（页字节构成、stride）、`glm52_pool_blocks`、`glm52_arena_bytes` 账本、两阶段构建的 `finish_kv`（真正分配 slab） |

| [src/mla_front.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs)、[src/moe_ep.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/moe_ep.rs) | 探测后落地的两笔「精确追加开销」：MLA q_a|kv_a 打包孪生、SM100 DeepGEMM 缓冲增量 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 精确账本 glm52_cap_bytes：一个候选 cap 的每一字节

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

要回答「这个 cap 放不放得下」，前提是能**精确**算出它花多少字节。GLM5.2 的选择是：把所有随 cap 与池块数线性变化的分配写成纯函数 `glm52_arena_bytes`（几何常量全部来自 u2-l1 的编译期 `const`），再加上投机通道的开销，就是 `glm52_cap_bytes`。精确账本带来两个直接收益：

- **可单测**：函数不碰 CUDA，测试可以拿假想的空闲字节数反演预算（见 4.2.4）。
- **可作边际差分**：账本对块数严格线性，`cost(blocks+1) − cost(blocks)` 就是每块的 slab 边际成本，实测填充直接拿它当单价（见 4.3）。

无法精确建模的部分不许混进账本，而是走 reserve 常量（4.2 讲），两类字节泾渭分明。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```text
glm52_cap_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, drafter, prefill_only, moe_topo)
  = glm52_arena_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, prefill_only)   # KV slab + 各类表
  + dspark ? glm52_dspark_arena_bytes(cap)              # DSpark 草稿通道（只随 cap 缩放）
  | mtp    ? glm52_mtp_arena_bytes(cap, pool_blocks, topo)  # native MTP（随 cap 与块数）
  | none   ? 0
```

`glm52_arena_bytes` 内部是五项求和：

1. **slab**：`pool_blocks × 3,503,040 B + 3,502,592 B`（每块一页 stride，外加一页内容的尾部余量）；
2. **rope 表**：`2 × cap × 32 × 2 B`（cos/sin，bf16）；
3. **indexer logits 桶缓冲**：所有 decode bucket 行数之和 × `cap` 向上取整到 256 × 6 B（bf16 + f32）；
4. **块表**：bucket 行数之和 × 表宽 × 4 B；
5. **prefill 解包池**（仅 prefill-only）：`pool_blocks × 64 × 512 × 2 B + pool_blocks × 4 B`。

其中一页的内容账是纯几何（u4-l2 展开）：

\[ 78 \times (64 \times 656) + 21 \times (64 \times 128 + 64 \times 4) + (64 \times 656) + (64 \times 128 + 64 \times 4) = 3{,}274{,}752 + 177{,}408 + 50{,}432 = 3{,}502{,}592 \text{ B} \]

即 78 个 MLA 切片 + 21 个 full-indexer 的 index-K 切片 + 第 78 层 MTP 镜像（一个 MLA 切片 + 一个 index-K 切片）。stride 把内容向上取整到 656-byte 的 token 行：\( 5{,}340 \times 656 = 3{,}503{,}040 \) B。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:660-675](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L660-L675) 是账本入口：固定构建 arena 加上所选投机通道的开销。

[model/mod.rs:205-240](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L205-L240) 是五项求和的实现；slab 一项就是 `块数 × GLM52_KV_PAGE_STRIDE + GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES`。

[model/mod.rs:139-163](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L139-L163) 钉死页的三个字节常量，并用编译期断言保证 stride 是 656 的倍数、pad 尾巴不足一行——这正是边际差分成立的前提。

[model/mod.rs:177-203](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L177-L203) `glm52_page_layout` 用同一份构造把内容账加出来并 `assert_eq!` 到 `GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES`——**布局函数和字节常量互为对方的测试**，谁漂移谁编译期/测试期爆红。

[model/mod.rs:112-130](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L112-L130) 定义对齐常量与 nominal 池公式：一个 slot 的终身页数是 \( \lceil (cap+1)/64 \rceil \)（+1 来自悬空 token 契约，u7-l4 展开），池再 `+1` 是 padding 页（block 0）。

[model/mod.rs:943-1021](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L943-L1021) 是消费端：`finish_kv` 真正 `alloc_zeros` 这块 slab，行数是 `pool_blocks + scratch_blocks`（EP MTP 的草稿 scratch 页排在池区之后），与账本公式逐字对应。

#### 4.1.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：亲手验证页内容账，确信 `3,502,592` 不是魔法数。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：prefill-only 形态下每多买一个池块，边际成本比 decode 形态多多少字节？
**答案**：多 `64 × 512 × 2 + 4 = 65,540` B（解包 bf16 KV 池 + 每块 4 字节），见 [model/mod.rs:230-238](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L230-L238) 的 `prefill_unpacked` 项；decode 形态该项为 0。

**练习 2**：为什么账本对 `pool_blocks` 必须严格线性？
**答案**：因为实测填充用 `cost(floor+1) − cost(floor)` 当每块单价（[lib.rs:1365-1382](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1365-L1382)）；只要账本线性，一次差分就是任意块数下的边际成本，除法即可换算块数。若存在非线性项（如按池大小分档的表），差分就不再代表单价。

### 4.2 derive_max_model_len：显式校验与自动二分

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

权重落 GPU 后，引擎从加载报告取 fleet 最小空闲 VRAM（[lib.rs:916-922](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L916-L922)），先精确扣掉两笔探测后才会落地的开销——MLA q_a|kv_a 打包孪生（[mla_front.rs:220-227](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L220-L227)）与 SM100 DeepGEMM 增量（[moe_ep.rs:69-73](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/moe_ep.rs#L69-L73)），见 [lib.rs:923-939](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L923-L939)。然后 `derive_max_model_len` 在这笔预算上做决策：

- **reserve 分层**：先扣经验 reserve 得到 `budget_bytes`：
  - `GLM52_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES = 5 GiB`（[lib.rs:599-611](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L599-L611)）：覆盖探测后无法精确建模的分配——MLA W_UK/W_UV 反量化净增量、DeepEP 集合通信缓冲、8 个整步 graph 实例、cuBLAS 工作区、碎片。注释里记录了 8×H200 实测最差 rank 约 3.05 GiB，留 ~2 GiB 余量。
  - DSpark 开启时再加 `GLM52_DSPARK_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES = 5 GiB`（复制式草稿权重 + dense scratch，在探测*之后*加载）。
  - prefill-only 再加 scratch 预留：`3 GiB 固定 + 160 KiB × chunk 行数`（[lib.rs:724-735](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L724-L735)）。
- **显式 cap**（用户给了 `--max-model-len`）：四道门全部通过才接受。
- **自动模式**：在 64 对齐候选上二分找「nominal 池也放得下」的最大 cap。
- **floor 池**：决策最后给出实测填充的下限——nominal 池（`slots × cap`）放得下就用 nominal（与旧行为一致），否则退到「一个满长请求」池。

设计哲学：**宁可启动失败，不可带病服务**。预算不足时错误消息把每个数字（需求、预算、reserve、探测值）都打出来，见 [lib.rs:792-802](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L792-L802)。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

```text
budget = min_free_vram − post_weight_charge − reserve
显式路径（requested = Some(C)）:
  1) C ≥ 4096（GLM52_MIN_MODEL_LEN）
  2) C ≤ 1,048,576（GLM52_MAX_CONTEXT，checkpoint 的 max_position_embeddings）
  3) C % 64 == 0（否则报出两侧最近的合法值）
  4) cap_bytes(C, one_request_pool(C)) + graph_reserve ≤ budget
自动路径（requested = None）:
  在 [0, MAX_CONTEXT/64] 上二分，谓词 = cap_bytes(c·64, nominal_pool(c·64)) ≤ budget
  结果 < 4096 则拒绝启动
floor:
  cap_bytes(cap, nominal) ≤ budget ? nominal : one_request(cap)
```

注意两条路径用的**池假设不同**：自动模式按 nominal（slots × cap）搜索——语义是「连传统并发池都放得下的最大 cap」；显式路径只需 one-request 池放得下（#818 解耦的核心：显式大 cap 合法，并发交给实测填充给）。二分正确性依赖账本对 cap 单调；`mid = ⌈(lo+hi)/2⌉` 保证区间长度为 1 时也能推进。

### 4.3 measured pool fill：两阶段构建与 slab 边际成本

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

cap 定了之后，池该买多少块？旧答案是 `slots × cap`（与 cap 耦合）；#818 之后改成**实测填充**：

1. 每个 worker 先做**阶段一构建**（`build_fixed`）：分配一切不随池大小变化的固定部分，然后**实测**本卡空闲 VRAM 并回报（[runner.rs:714-741](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L714-L741)）。
2. 引擎取 fleet 最小值，减去 graph reserve（默认 3 GiB，`GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB` 可覆盖）与**已知的 post-finish 开销**（DeepGEMM 缓冲、DSpark 草稿权重，[lib.rs:987-992](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L987-L992)），再除以账本差分出的每块 slab 单价，就是可负担块数；但它**永远不低于 floor**（[lib.rs:704-715](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L704-L715)）。
3. 每个 worker 做**阶段二**（`finish_kv`）：按定好的块数分配 slab 并回报（[runner.rs:743-763](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L743-L763)）。

好处：**池容量与 cap 解耦**。同一个 cap 下，显存多就多买页（更多并发、更长前缀缓存驻留），显存少就少买页；cap 只受 one-request 门槛约束。调度侧的 `BlockPool` 与 admission（u7-l4）按页数做终身预留，所以池小一点也不影响正确性，只影响并发度。

两道栅栏保护 `GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS`（手工钉死池大小的 A/B 旋钮）：

- **下栅栏**：pin ≥ one-request 池——低于它等于宣传一个任何请求都放不下的 cap，admission 会让不可能的请求永远堵在 FIFO 头。
- **上栅栏**：pin ≤ 实测可负担块数——高于它要么 slab 分配直接失败，要么吃掉 graph reserve 死在预捕获。

两道都「拒绝启动，报出数字」，见 [lib.rs:1387-1413](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1387-L1413)。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
阶段一: 所有 worker build_fixed → 各自回报 free_vram（全部回报后才继续）
min_free = min(回报值)
usable = min_free − graph_reserve(默认 3 GiB) − post_finish_reserve
blocks  = max(usable / slab_bytes_per_block, floor_blocks)
   其中 slab_bytes_per_block = cap_bytes(floor+1) − cap_bytes(floor)   # 账本差分
GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS=P 时:
   P ≥ one_request(cap) 且 P ≤ blocks(以 one_request 为 floor 重算) 才接受 P
阶段二: 所有 worker finish_kv(blocks)
```

两个阶段**刻意分开**：阶段一可能 OOM 或打包漂移失败，必须所有 rank 都报成功才有人进入阶段二——否则一个 rank 失败会把同伴晾在集合通信初始化里（[lib.rs:1319-1327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1319-L1327) 的 doc 详述了这个失败语义）。

[lib.rs:1874-1891](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1874-L1891) 实测填充的单测：三个断言分别覆盖「只剩 reserve 时 floor 不缩水」「每字节按边际单价买块」「已知 post-finish 开销与 reserve 一并扣减」。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么实测填充只在阶段一与阶段二**之间**做，而不是加载权重前就定好池？
**答案**：因为只有阶段一之后，所有固定分配（权重、buckets、rope 表、indexer 桶缓冲）才真正落地，空闲 VRAM 才是可信的测量值；加载前估算要复刻整个 CUDA 分配器的行为，必然回到经验常量。两阶段构建让「测量」成为可能（[lib.rs:1319-1327](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1319-L1327)）。

**练习 2**：`GLM52_GRAPH_RESERVE_GIB` 是池填充里「唯一剩下的估计」（[lib.rs:683-690](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L683-L690)）。为什么它不像 5 GiB reserve 那样拆成精确项？
**答案**：它能覆盖的开销（懒捕获的整步 graph 实例、cuBLAS/FlashInfer 工作区、碎片）没有常量公式可依，且发生在 FinishKv *之后*——此时已无法再改池大小，只能预留。做成旋钮允许在实测漂移时手工调大调小做 A/B。

**练习 3**：nominal 池作 floor 有什么兼容性意义？
**答案**：显存宽裕时 `max(usable/单价, nominal) = nominal` 附近，行为与解耦前的旧默认几乎一致（单测 `floor_is_the_nominal_pool_when_the_ledger_affords_it`，[lib.rs:1844-1853](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1844-L1853)）；floor 只在「显式大 cap 挤掉了 nominal」时才退到 one-request——解耦是**放宽**约束而非改变默认。

### 4.4 post-build headroom 再探测

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

预算再精确也是模型。若 reserve/账本随代码演进漂移（比如新加一条未入账的分配），错误应该在**启动期**爆出来，而不是服务中途 OOM——后者在 EP fleet 里意味着集体通信组整体坍塌、难以归因。所以构建完成后引擎再探一次每 rank 的空闲 VRAM，低于 `GLM52_POST_BUILD_MIN_FREE_BYTES = 1 GiB` 就拒绝启动（[lib.rs:632-637](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L632-L637)）：这 1 GiB 是 graph 实例化与碎片的最小呼吸空间。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
FinishKv 全员完成 → SetupComm 之前/前后（post_comm_startup 闭包内）
对每个 worker 异步发 FreeVram 探测 → 回收每 rank 空闲值
free < 1 GiB ? 启动失败（错误带具体数字） : 记 info 日志继续
```

它在 [lib.rs:1034-1041](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1034-L1041) 的 `post_comm_startup` 闭包里被调用，位于 prefill kernel 预检与 DSpark 草稿加载之后、KV store 构建之前。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

[lib.rs:1293-1317](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1293-L1317) `ensure_post_build_headroom`：全员异步探测、逐 rank 校验、失败消息建议「调低 --max-model-len 或释放显存」，成功则把每 rank 空闲值打进日志。

[runner.rs:740](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L740) 与 [runner.rs:694](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/runner.rs#L694) 是同一探测原语的三个使用点：权重加载报告、阶段一回报、显式 FreeVram 指令——一次实现，三处复用。

[mla_front.rs:213-219](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/mla_front.rs#L213-L219) 的 doc 是这条防线的注脚：q_a|kv_a 孪生约 1.2 GiB 若不入账，「未入账的分配会吃掉 post-build headroom 地板」；混合架构 fleet 里账本可能算错，re-probe 是兜底。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

1. **实践目标**：源码阅读型实践——追踪一次「账本漂移」如何被 re-probe 拦截。
2. **操作步骤**：
   - 假想有人给 `finish_kv` 增加了一块 1.5 GiB 的未入账缓冲（不要真的改）。
   - 沿启动时序标注：4.2 的显式/自动 cap 校验（ unaware）→ 4.3 的实测填充（unaware）→ FinishKv 真正分配 → re-probe。
   - 查 [lib.rs:1303-1309](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1303-L1309) 的错误消息文案，确认它把 rank 号、实测空闲值与地板值都打了出来。
3. **需要观察的现象**：漂移缓冲把某 rank 空闲压到 1 GiB 以下时，启动在这里失败并给出可行动的信息，而不是服务几分钟后 OOM。
4. **预期结果**：能写出「哪一步发现、报什么数字、用户被建议做什么」三段式结论；此为静态分析，无需运行。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：re-probe 的地板是 1 GiB，而 4.2 的 reserve 是 5 GiB，两者矛盾吗？
**答案**：不矛盾，层次不同。5 GiB reserve 是*进入预算前*的经验扣减（覆盖账本外开销并留余量）；1 GiB 是*全部构建完成后*的最终校验地板——若实际只花了 reserve 的一半，re-probe 会放行更多隐性余量；若开销超预算，re-probe 兜底。前者防超支，后者防漂移。

**练习 2**：为什么 re-probe 失败是可接受的启动失败，而服务中途 OOM 不可接受？
**答案**：启动失败发生在任何集合通信组进入长生命周期之前（或配合广播 Shutdown 拆除，见 [lib.rs:993-1001](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L993-L1001)），错误定位直接；服务中 OOM 会让一个 rank 掉队，free-running fleet 里其余 rank 全速空转直到 DeepEP 超时（约 100 s），事后难以归因。这与 u7-l1 的 fate-sharing 纪律一脉相承。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：写一个「GLM5.2 显存预算模拟器」，把本讲三段决策串成一条链。**

用 Python 复刻公式（**示例代码**，非项目源码，数字以源码常量为准）：

```python
# 示例代码：GLM5.2 显存预算模拟器（decode / EP8 / 无 drafter 的简化版）
PAGE_STRIDE = 3_503_040          # model/mod.rs GLM52_KV_PAGE_STRIDE
CONTENT     = 3_502_592          # GLM52_KV_PAGE_CONTENT_BYTES
MLA_TOKENS  = 576 // 9           # 每层 rope 半维 32 * 2 表 * bf16 —— 见下方练习
RESERVE     = 5 << 30            # lib.rs GLM52_VRAM_RESERVE_BYTES
GRAPH_RESERVE = 3 << 30          # glm52_graph_reserve_bytes 默认
MIN_LEN, MAX_CTX, ALIGN = 4096, 1_048_576, 64
BUCKET_ROWS = sum([1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 48, 64, 96])   # GLM52_DECODE_BUCKETS 之和
SLOTS = 8

def arena(cap, blocks):                      # model/mod.rs glm52_arena_bytes 的 decode 分支
    slab = blocks * PAGE_STRIDE + CONTENT
    rope = 2 * cap * 32 * 2
    logits = BUCKET_ROWS * ((cap + 255) // 256 * 256) * (2 + 4)
    tables = BUCKET_ROWS * ((cap + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN) * 4
    return slab + rope + logits + tables

cap_bytes = arena                             # 无 drafter 时 glm52_cap_bytes == arena
one_request = lambda c: (c + 1 + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN + 2
nominal = lambda c: SLOTS * ((c + 1 + ALIGN - 1) // ALIGN) + 1

def derive(free_after_weights):
    budget = free_after_weights - RESERVE
    lo, hi = 0, MAX_CTX // ALIGN
    while lo < hi:                            # lib.rs:804-833 的二分
        mid = (lo + hi + 1) // 2
        if cap_bytes(mid * ALIGN, nominal(mid * ALIGN)) <= budget: lo = mid
        else: hi = mid - 1
    cap = lo * ALIGN
    assert cap >= MIN_LEN
    floor = nominal(cap) if cap_bytes(cap, nominal(cap)) <= budget else one_request(cap)
    return cap, floor, budget

def fill(free_after_fixed, floor):            # lib.rs:704-715 实测填充
    usable = free_after_fixed - GRAPH_RESERVE
    unit = cap_bytes(0, floor + 1) - cap_bytes(0, floor)   # 差分 = PAGE_STRIDE
    return max(usable // unit, floor)

# 场景：权重后空闲 30 GiB、固定构建后 fleet 最小空闲 22 GiB
cap, floor, budget = derive(30 << 30)
blocks = fill(22 << 30, floor)
print(f"cap={cap}, floor={floor} blocks, pool={blocks} blocks (~{blocks*64/1024:.0f}K tokens)")
```

要求：

1. 跑通后回答：这个场景推导出多大的 cap？池比 nominal 多出多少块？
2. 修改 `SLOTS = 32`（对照 `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS`，[model/mod.rs:101-110](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/model/mod.rs#L101-L110)），解释 cap 为什么变小、池为什么几乎不变——这正是「cap 与池解耦」的直观演示。
3. 找出代码里的一处故意留白（`MLA_TOKENS` 那行是干扰项，rope 项已在 `arena` 里实现）：删掉它。
4. 对照 [lib.rs:950-979](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L950-L979) 与 [lib.rs:1422-1434](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1422-L1434) 的真实日志字段，列出模拟器没建模的项（DSpark/MTP 通道、prefill scratch、post-finish 开销、DeepGEMM 计费、TP4 专属缓存）。

注意：模拟器只做教学推演；真实数字以启动日志为准。运行结果**待本地验证**。

## 6. 本讲小结

- **精确账本**：`glm52_cap_bytes = glm52_arena_bytes + 投机通道`，五项求和全部来自编译期几何常量，对 cap 与块数严格线性；线性性让「一次差分 = 每块 slab 单价（3,503,040 B）」。
- **cap 决策**：`derive_max_model_len` 不碰 CUDA 所以可单测；显式 cap 过四道门（最小值、checkpoint 上限、64 对齐、one-request 池 + graph reserve 放得下），自动模式按 nominal 池二分；两条路径的池假设不同是 #818 解耦的体现。
- **reserve 分层**：5 GiB 基础 reserve（账本外开销）+ DSpark 5 GiB + prefill scratch（3 GiB + 160 KiB/行）+ graph reserve（默认 3 GiB，池填充侧）+ 精确扣减（q_a|kv_a 孪生、DeepGEMM 增量）——精确与经验两类字节分开记账。
- **实测填充**：两阶段构建（build_fixed → 实测 fleet 最小空闲 → finish_kv），池 = max(可用字节 ÷ slab 单价, floor)；`GLM52_KV_POOL_BLOCKS` 被上下两道栅栏夹住，越界即拒绝启动。
- **headroom 再探测**：构建完成后每 rank 空闲须 ≥ 1 GiB，把账本漂移变成带数字的启动失败而非服务中 OOM。
- **日志即合同**：启动日志打出的每个数字与决策、单测消费的是同一组值（`free_for` 用同一账本反演），三者不会漂移。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

- **u4-l2（KV 页布局）**：本讲把页当成 3.5 MB 的黑盒单价；下一讲拆开它——78 个 MLA 切片与 21 个 index-K 切片在一页内如何排布、为什么 stride 必须是 656 的倍数。
- **u7-l4（admission）**：池解耦之后，「一个请求终身要多少页」的公式 \( \lceil (prompt + max\_tokens)/64 \rceil \)（含悬空 token 的 +1）在 admission 里变成 honor-or-reject 的预留纪律，是池容量决定的并发语义的另一半。
- **u7-l5（分页 KV 前缀缓存）**：实测填充买来的池块由 `BlockPool` 管理，释放块按内容哈希匹配成前缀缓存——池的「多买」部分直接转化为缓存驻留能力。
- 顺手阅读 [lib.rs:1789-2097](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/09a1a38f8b4938b06ee4e4f63f64fd4feed59434/pegainfer-glm52/src/lib.rs#L1789-L2097) 的整个 `max_model_len_tests` 模块：它是「策略纯函数化 + 同一账本反演」测试范式的最佳样例，值得在你自己的项目里复制。
